name: Rahul Sharma
headline: I photograph cities, and the quiet things in between.
bio: Mostly on foot, mostly after the rain, when the streets turn into mirrors. I shoot with whatever is in my pocket and keep the frames that still feel like the moment.
quote: "You don’t take a photograph, you make it." — Ansel Adams
now: chasing reflections around Marina Bay after the evening showers. Carrying a Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.
